verses.text: Sarah lived to be a hundred and twenty-seven years old.
She died at Kiriath Arba, which is Hebron, in the land of Canaan. Abraham went to mourn for Sarah and to weep over her.
Then Abraham got up from beside his dead wife and spoke to the Hittites. He said,
"I am a foreigner and a stranger among you. Sell me some land for a burial place here, so that I can bury my dead wife."
The Hittites answered Abraham,
"Sir, listen to us. You are a mighty prince among us. Bury your dead in the best of our tombs. None of us will refuse you his tomb for burying your dead."
Then Abraham got up and bowed down in front of the people of the land, the Hittites.
He said to them, "If you are willing to let me bury my dead, then listen to me. Ask Ephron son of Zohar on my behalf
to sell me the cave of Machpelah, which belongs to him and is at the end of his field. Ask him to sell it to me for the full price, so that I can own it as a burial place among you."
Ephron the Hittite was sitting among his people. He answered Abraham in front of all the Hittites who had come to the gate of his city.
"No, sir, listen to me. I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it. I give it to you in front of my people. Bury your dead."
Again Abraham bowed down in front of the people of the land.
And he said to Ephron in front of them all, "Please listen to me. I will pay the price of the field. Accept it from me, so that I can bury my dead there."
Ephron answered Abraham,
"Listen to me, sir. The land is worth four hundred pieces of silver, but what is that between you and me? Bury your dead."
Abraham agreed to Ephron's price. He weighed out for him the price he had named in front of the Hittites: four hundred pieces of silver, by the weight used by the traders of the time.
So Ephron's field in Machpelah, near Mamre, became Abraham's. This included the field and the cave in it, and all the trees within the borders of the field.
It became Abraham's property in front of all the Hittites who had come to the gate of the city.
After this, Abraham buried his wife Sarah in the cave in the field of Machpelah, near Mamre, which is at Hebron in the land of Canaan.
So the field and the cave in it were handed over to Abraham by the Hittites as his own burial place.
